Package org.example.dao

Class JDBCMovieDao

java.lang.Object
org.example.dao.JDBCMovieDao
All Implemented Interfaces:
DAO<Movie>, MovieDao
public class JDBCMovieDao extends Object implements MovieDao
JDBC implementation of MovieDao.

Provides CRUD operations and search queries for Movie entities using plain JDBC and SQL queries.

This class uses:

  • ConnectionFactory to obtain database connections
  • RowMapper (MovieMapper) to map ResultSet rows to Movie objects
